groups.name: Tops
groups.definition: A garment worn on the upper body that is not the outer layer over another top.

groups.name: Bottoms
groups.definition: A garment worn on the lower body.

groups.name: One-piece
groups.definition: A single garment that covers both the upper and lower body.

groups.name: Outerwear
groups.definition: A layer worn over other clothing, usually for warmth or weather.

groups.name: Footwear
groups.definition: A garment worn on the feet.

groups.name: Accessories
groups.definition: An item worn or carried with an outfit that is not a primary clothing garment.

t-shirt.name: T-shirt
t-shirt.prompt: a t-shirt with short sleeves, a round neck, and no collar
t-shirt.definition: A casual knit top with short sleeves and a crew or v-neck, without a collar.

shirt.name: Shirt
shirt.prompt: a button-up shirt with a collar
shirt.definition: A woven button-up top with a collar, including dress shirts and casual button-ups.

polo.name: Polo
polo.prompt: a polo shirt with a collar and a short button placket
polo.definition: A knit top with a collar and a short buttoned placket.

blouse.name: Blouse
blouse.prompt: a blouse, a soft dressy top that is not a structured button-up shirt
blouse.definition: A softer or dressier top, often draped, that is not a structured button-up shirt.

sweater.name: Sweater
sweater.definition: A knitted pullover worn for warmth, without a hood.

hoodie.name: Hoodie
hoodie.prompt: a hooded sweatshirt with a hood
hoodie.definition: A sweatshirt with an attached hood.

tank-top.name: Tank top
tank-top.definition: A sleeveless top with a low armhole and no collar.

sweatshirt.name: Sweatshirt
sweatshirt.prompt: a crewneck sweatshirt without a hood
sweatshirt.definition: A fleece or French-terry pullover with ribbed cuffs and no hood.

trousers.name: Trousers
trousers.prompt: a pair of dress trousers that are not denim and not chinos
trousers.definition: Full-length pants that are not denim and not cotton-twill chinos, usually dress pants.

chinos.name: Chinos
chinos.prompt: a pair of chino pants in cotton twill
chinos.definition: Casual full-length cotton-twill pants, lighter than jeans and less formal than dress trousers.

shorts.name: Shorts
shorts.prompt: a pair of shorts ending above the knee
shorts.definition: Pants that end above the knee.

skirt.name: Skirt
skirt.definition: A lower-body garment that hangs from the waist and does not separate the legs.

leggings.name: Leggings
leggings.prompt: a pair of tight stretch leggings
leggings.definition: Tight stretch pants that follow the leg, including opaque tights worn as pants.

dress.name: Dress
dress.definition: A one-piece garment with a bodice and a skirt.

jumpsuit.name: Jumpsuit
jumpsuit.definition: A one-piece garment with long pants.

romper.name: Romper
romper.definition: A one-piece garment whose bottom is shorts.

jacket.name: Jacket
jacket.prompt: a jacket that ends around the hip
jacket.definition: A short outer layer, typically ending around the hip, that is not a tailored blazer.

coat.name: Coat
coat.prompt: a long coat that falls past the hip
coat.definition: An outer layer that falls past the hip and is not specifically a trench coat or raincoat.

blazer.name: Blazer
blazer.definition: A tailored jacket, often with lapels, worn as part of suiting or smart casual dress.

trench-coat.name: Trench coat
trench-coat.prompt: a belted trench coat with a storm flap
trench-coat.definition: A long belted raincoat-style coat with a storm flap, usually gabardine.

raincoat.name: Raincoat
raincoat.definition: A waterproof outer layer meant for rain that is not cut as a trench coat.

sneakers.name: Sneakers
sneakers.definition: Athletic or casual shoes with a rubber sole and a closed upper.

boots.name: Boots
boots.prompt: a pair of boots that cover the ankle
boots.definition: Footwear that extends to or above the ankle.

sandals.name: Sandals
sandals.definition: Open footwear that leaves most of the foot exposed.

formal-shoes.name: Formal shoes
formal-shoes.prompt: a pair of formal leather oxford or derby shoes
formal-shoes.definition: Closed dress shoes such as oxfords or derbies, with a low heel.

flats.name: Flats
flats.prompt: a pair of flat shoes with no raised heel
flats.definition: Closed, low-cut shoes with no raised heel.

hat.name: Hat
hat.definition: A hat, cap, or beanie worn on the head. A hood sewn onto a hoodie is not a hat.

scarf.name: Scarf
scarf.prompt: a scarf worn around the neck
scarf.definition: A length of fabric worn around the neck.

belt.name: Belt
belt.prompt: a belt worn at the waist
belt.definition: A strap worn around the waist over clothing.

bag.name: Bag
bag.definition: A bag carried or worn with an outfit, including handbags, totes, and backpacks.

gloves.name: Gloves
gloves.definition: A covering worn on the hands.

other-accessories.name: Other accessories
other-accessories.prompt: a fashion accessory such as glasses, a tie, or jewelry
other-accessories.definition: An accessory that is not a hat, scarf, belt, bag, or gloves, such as glasses, a tie, or jewelry.

ambiguous_cases.guidance: Use shirt for a structured button-up with a collar. Use blouse for a softer or dressier top. Fashionpedia merges these into one class, so that source row is not used for training.
A polo has a collar and a placket. A tank top has no sleeves. A t-shirt has sleeves and no collar. DeepFashion2 short-sleeve tops mix these, so that mapping is weak.
A sweater is knit. A sweatshirt is fleece or French terry without a hood. A hoodie is a sweatshirt with a hood. Fashionpedia's combined top class is not mapped.

Jeans are denim. Chinos are cotton twill. Trousers are other full-length pants, usually dress pants. DeepFashion2 trousers and Fashionpedia pants mix these, so those rows are weak and are not treated as jeans.
A jacket ends around the hip. A coat is longer. A blazer is tailored. A trench coat is a belted coat with a storm flap. A raincoat is a waterproof shell that is not a trench.
A dress has a skirt. A jumpsuit has long pants. A romper has shorts. Public datasets rarely separate rompers, so romper stays zero-shot.
Datasets that only say shoe are not mapped. A boot covers the ankle. Sandals are open. Heels have a raised heel. Flats do not. Sneakers are athletic. Formal shoes are closed dress shoes.
DeepFashion2 vest, Fashionpedia vest, and Fashionpedia cardigan are skipped. They are not forced into tank-top or sweater. A generic shoe label is skipped so it is not stored as sneakers.
